title: Dino Nuggets
description: Changes chicken to dinosaur shaped nuggets.
body:
This resource pack retextures raw chicken as chicken fillet. Cooked chicken becomes a fun, T-Rex shaped dinosaur nugget! Perfect for picky eaters.

![The furnace UI showing Chicken Fillet being cooked into a dino nugget.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a6d104b742aa17acb6d33e0de7fc09cb8f7e45a0.png)

![The furnace UI showing a chicken fillet being cooked into a Dino Nugget.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbeef8a88d50641224c14ab067ec4057ec469188.png)
